events.title: Can Draganfly Leverage US Defense Partnerships to Drive Growth?
events.body: DPRO gains traction with US Air Force and Army deals, boosting its NDAA-compliant drone push while driving efficiency and future defense contract potential.

events.title: Ondas Secures $50M+ Demining Deal, Expands Border Security Platform
events.body: ONDS wins major demining contract via 4M Defense, with potential orders topping $50M, boosting its role in a $1.7B border security initiative.
